messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — customer asks (FinTech X) want a Console view that explains where inference spend is coming from + surface error signals. My proposal: MVP = dashboard (cost by route + error trend), a lightweight trace hook for sampled traces, and per-route estimated cost. Thoughts?

Jon (Eng): Sounds sensible. 1% trace sampling for MVP probably fine, but careful with ingest pipeline. We should make sampling adjustable per-customer.

Priya (SRE): +1. Also we need a hard cap on retained traces per org (default 7d). Prefer exposing a per-route sampling slider in Console instead of only global. Risk: trace backpressure under spike.

Alex (Data): For the cost breakdown we can surface an "estimated cost" column using token counts * model-cost-profile. It won't be invoice-level accurate (esp. embeddings), but good for triage. We can add a 95% CI and a note.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Implementation sketch: (a) dashboard panels using existing metrics + a small ETL for route aggregation, (b) trace hook that emits only span IDs + top-level metadata (no full spans by default), (c) streaming cost meter that updates per-route counters. If we keep trace payload tiny we can demo in 2 sprints.

Maya (PM): Suggest launch criteria: (1) Dashboard shows top-5 cost routes + error-rate + estimated cost, (2) Trace hook enabled for at least one canary customer with sampling controls, (3) No measurable regression on p95 request latency in canary, (4) Docs + migration notes + UX tooltip explaining estimate.

Jon (Eng): Note on rollout config — propose this snippet for config/console.yml: 
```
trace_hook:
  enabled: true
  sampling_rate: 0.01  # default 1%
  per_customer_override: true
  retention_days: 7
```
We'll gate retention and payload size to avoid OOMs.

Priya (SRE): Operational risk: token-based estimates will undercount embedding-heavy workloads. Add a workload classifier flag so we label routes as "textgen" vs "embeddings" and show a warning if mismatch. Also add an alert if trace ingest rate > 5x baseline.

Alex (Data): UX suggestion: show both "estimated cost" and "model profile" (e.g., gpt-3-like, small-embed) with a short explanation: "Estimates use model profiles; actual invoice may differ." This will reduce support tickets.

Maya (PM): Action items: Sam owns dashboard (ETA sprint-1), Jon owns trace-hook + rollout (sprint-1), Alex owns estimated-cost algo + UI labels (sprint-1), Priya owns SLO guardrails and alerts (sprint-1). I'll file the customer ask and schedule a 30m review next Tue. @Sam please confirm. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng-Platform): Confirmed. I'll publish the proposal doc and include the minimal telemetry proto. Will tag everyone. :+1:

MetricsBot: New perf alert template created: `console.obs.trace_hook_latency` (threshold: p95 > 150ms).
